newsitem.title: GERMANY: German roaster Eduscho raises mild coffee price.
newsitem.headline: German roaster Eduscho raises mild coffee price.

text.p: German coffee roaster Eduscho GmbH & Co KG in a statement said it would raise the retail price of its brand "Milde Natur" by one mark to 7.99 marks per 0.5 kg on February 3.

Eduscho, which accounts for around 11 percent of total German roasted coffee sales, said the price increase was necessary because of futures rises in New York and because of strong dollar gains versus the mark.
"The procurements cost of high quality washed arabicas from the new crop used in 'Milde Natur' have risen by more than 30 percent since last September," the roaster said.
Official price rise announcements are rare in the fiercely competitive German coffee market and they may prompt similar moves by other companies, analysts said.
Many roasters lost money last year and Eduscho, itself a victim of the price fights, will be taken over by Tchibo Holding AG, pending cartel office approval.
